visual.problem: The animated grid of refrigerators overlaps with the captions ('աղբանոցում են։ Տեսնում ենք միայն'), causing visual clutter in the lower half of the frame.
The bomber diagram box is relatively small with wide black borders around it, making the bullet hole dots hard to see clearly on small mobile phone screens.

hook.why: It opens with a relatable everyday trope (grandma's Soviet fridge outliving modern appliances) paired with real local footage from the Yerevan Zoo, instantly piquing curiosity before flipping the assumption.

pacing.problem: Rushing through three rapid-fire examples in 20 seconds (old music, smoking grandpa, college dropouts) immediately after the main airplane story creates brief cognitive overload and bloats the video past the 60-second mark.

clarity.summary_of_what_a_viewer_learns: The viewer learns the concept of survivorship bias: why people mistakenly assume old products or past trends were superior simply because failed examples are filtered out and invisible.

top_3_fixes: Cut one of the secondary examples (such as the old songs or smoking grandpa) to bring the total duration under 60 seconds for higher short-form retention.
Shift the refrigerator grid graphic upward at 00:10 to prevent it from overlapping with the text captions.
Enlarge the WWII bomber illustration at 00:16–00:30 so the bullet hole markers and unprotected areas are more prominent on mobile displays.
